name: gitlab
description: Inspect and operate GitLab projects through the bundled self-hosted MCP server with safe shared-token or per-user OAuth workflows for Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted GitLab MCP with per-user OAuth
interface.longDescription: Use the bundled self-hosted GitLab MCP server to inspect projects, review merge requests, manage issues, debug pipelines, and publish controlled changes to GitLab.com or GitLab Self-Managed. Deploy with a shared service token for trusted single-user use or per-user OAuth so every MCP client receives the permissions of its own GitLab identity.
defaultPrompt: List the GitLab groups and projects I can access.
Review the current GitLab merge request and address feedback.
Create a GitLab issue or merge request after confirming the target.
